tasks.label: README: capture screenshots
tasks.command: Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; pnpm run build:nocheck; $env:README_SHOT_DIR = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'readme-screenshots'; pnpm run ui:shots:readme; if (Test-Path $env:README_SHOT_DIR) { Invoke-Item $env:README_SHOT_DIR }
